complete_high_subgroup_denominator.proof_of_exhaustion: If Fix(H) has rank at least 11, every element of H has individual fixed rank at least 11.  The 81 possibilities are all involutions.  For two distinct such elements their product is again high; hence it is an involution, the two commute, and they generate one of the 120 enumerated V4 groups.  Every such V4 has common fixed rank 7 or 8.  Therefore a proper high subgroup is C2, in exactly the two classes above.
